summary: No installer-harm behavior identified in signalledger-bridge@2.0.6
details: Review of the package's shipped contents produced no findings indicating installer-side attack behavior. No install-time or import-time network fetch-and-execute, no reads of installer credential paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores), no environment scraping, no hardcoded attacker network destination, no lifecycle-script dropper, no silent-relay of caller-supplied data, and no backdoor or persistence mechanism were observed in the tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
